concepts.initialPrompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a high fidelity professional product design concept board for N4x4, an existing native iPhone Norwegian 4x4 interval training app, adapting to Apple's iPhone Duo. Wide landscape canvas, graphite studio background, meticulous typography and alignment, no hands or decorative gym objects. Title at top left "A / WORKOUT, EXPANDED", subtitle "One session. More room to breathe." Small footer "N4x4 · Design concept · Illustrative data". Two device mockups front facing aligned at their bottom edge: left smaller CLOSED outer screen with width:height exactly about 0.69 (wide short portrait phone, not tall modern iPhone), right larger OPEN inner screen width:height exactly about 1.42 (landscape tablet shaped phone). The open screen should have same physical height as closed screen and nearly double its width. Thin dark titanium frames, asymmetric outer screen flat left corners, rounded right corners. The outer front camera is a small black circle near TOP RIGHT CORNER, never a centered pill. On the inner display no visible camera. A slim native glass vertical tab strip along the RIGHT outer edge of each display, above tabs tiny system status indicators, tabs Home selected blue, History, Guide, Settings as familiar icons. Keep content inset from this rail. No horizontal bottom tab bars in these landscape-open and portrait-closed poses.
Brand: near black #0A0A0D, charcoal rounded surfaces #171A1F, white SF-like rounded bold numerals, blue #2E85FF, amber #FF9400 for work phase, instant in-zone green #30D158. Hero ring is the existing N4x4 signature: elegant brushed chrome metal circular bezel with a thin amber luminous outer rim, dark center, restrained soft glow, no sci-fi machinery.
Both displays show IDENTICAL ongoing session: "Norwegian 4×4", "ROUND 2 OF 4", countdown "02:38", ring caption "HIGH INTENSITY", heart rate "166" green with "BPM", large white target "153–171" under "TARGET BPM", green check icon and "In zone". Clear "CURRENT HEART RATE" label. Workout pause and skip buttons easily tapped, Finish separate near heading. Closed layout: modest header; small horizontal segmented full-session timeline with warmup blue, four amber work blocks interleaved with green recovery and cyan cooldown. Compact chrome countdown ring above a compact wide HR card, two clear "Pause" and "Skip" buttons at bottom within safe area. Fit all without tiny text. Open layout: a spacious TWO COLUMN experience; same chrome countdown ring MUCH larger in left column with segmented session timeline below. Right column generous CURRENT HEART RATE card with huge 166, white target, textual In zone, source "Apple Watch", small zone strip labeled Z1 Z2 Z3 Z4 Z5; below it a compact row "UP NEXT" "Recovery · 3:00" and "90–114 BPM". Pause and Skip in wide row below HR. Keep generous quiet gap through vertical CENTER of open device so no numerals, ring, cards or controls cross potential hinge region. Prioritize clear readable information over dense metrics. Beautiful premium native iOS design grounded in implementable SwiftUI. No live chart on this board. No invented sensors, calories, AI, maps or ECG trace. This is a design exploration, not an official screenshot.

concepts.initialPrompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a high fidelity premium N4x4 native iPhone Duo workout design concept board on graphite studio background. Wide canvas. Heading "B / HANDS-FREE TRAINING", subheading "Visible at a distance. Easy to control." Footer "N4x4 · Design concept · Illustrative data". Show TWO related device views: at left a front facing FULLY OPEN landscape Duo width:height about 1.42 with thin titanium frame; at right an attractive three-quarter perspective of the SAME phone rotated into tall portrait and PARTIALLY FOLDED along its HORIZONTAL midline, like a laptop resting on a surface. Upper half tilted back so workout information is visible at distance; lower half lies mostly horizontal as a touch deck. This is ONE continuous inner folding display, not two separate hinged screens with giant bezel. Leave content away from fold. Do not show any exterior screen simultaneously. Realistically match content perspective on upper and lower panels. Inner camera is invisible, no pill at top.
N4x4 identity: near-black #0A0A0D, charcoal cards #171A1F, electric blue #2E85FF actions, amber #FF9400 work phase, green #30D158 in-zone reading, rounded bold SF-like type. Signature circular brushed CHROME ring and restrained thin amber glow surrounding bold countdown. Not a sci-fi control panel.
The fully open view is a calm training dashboard split into left and right regions with clear empty center gutter: left large chrome ring reading "02:38", "HIGH INTENSITY", small heading "ROUND 2 OF 4"; right large "CURRENT HEART RATE" heading with heart icon, giant green "166", "BPM", clear white "TARGET BPM" "153–171", green check and "In zone", source "Apple Watch". Beneath right HR is a secondary compact non-ECG line chart of BPM across elapsed workout, label "HEART RATE THIS SESSION", green/amber line with visible gaps where no samples exist and a faint shaded target band, only a few time labels. This CHART IS A PROPOSED NEW FEATURE so add a small outside-device annotation "Optional live HR trend". Lower area Pause and Skip, separated Finish action near the top. Slim native glass Home/History/Guide/Settings tab icons along RIGHT edge, tiny system indicators above them.
In the half-folded portrait view use the natural horizontal regions: upper display holds easily readable chrome timer "02:38" with "HIGH INTENSITY" plus current 166 green and white target 153–171, textual In zone; lower display holds two huge separate "Pause" and "Skip" controls, compact session timeline and "UP NEXT · Recovery · 3:00". Finish is a distinct smaller action, not the main control. No key information spans the horizontal bend. In portrait-open half-folded pose native navigation may sit at bottom of lower region as compact glass tab bar, no extra tab rail. Keep all core functionality available. Restrained glow, very polished believable fitness product. Board should communicate how the same content naturally rearranges around the fold; no extra marketing paragraphs, fabricated hardware specs, calories, speed predictions, maps, ECG waveforms, or app implementation jargon.

Use case: ui-mockup. Create a beautifully polished high fidelity N4x4 iPhone Duo design exploration board, wide canvas on dark graphite background. Header "C / BEFORE & AFTER", subtitle "Prepare on one side. See the full picture on the other." Footer "N4x4 · Design concept · Illustrative data". Two large front-facing FULLY OPEN iPhone Duo inner-display device mockups side by side, each screen landscape aspect ratio width:height approximately 1.42, thin titanium dark frames, no visible inner camera, no centered pill. Label first "HOME · OPEN" and second "HISTORY · OPEN" above their devices. Devices fill most board width so text remains legible. Native slim glass vertical tab rail on RIGHT edge in both, Home/History/Guide/Settings icons with appropriate destination blue, tiny system status above. Content respects asymmetric rail safe area. Keep a wide central gutter through each screen for potential fold, avoid cards and primary text crossing center. No bottom tab bars for these landscape-open screens.
Visual brand is existing N4x4: near black #0A0A0D, charcoal cards #171A1F, electric blue #2E85FF, amber #FF9400 work intervals and streak, recovery green, white SF-like rounded bold typography. Signature large START button is a simple dark center with circular brushed chrome bezel, subtle glow amber on left blue on right, crisp white "START" inside.
HOME: two columns, left above START ring small orange flame "9" and "WEEK STREAK", large inviting START ring. Right elegant panel "Norwegian 4×4", "4 intervals · 40 min", compact horizontal blue warmup/amber work/green recovery/cyan cooldown session timeline. Small structured workout preview rows "Warm up 10:00", "Work 4 × 4:00", "Recovery 3 × 3:00", "Cool down 5:00". Small source row "Apple Watch" with ready check. Clear target card "WORK TARGET" "153–171 BPM". Supporting low-key label "Your plan" near preview. No second workout type picker and no invented metrics.
HISTORY: a native list-and-detail split. Left region narrower but about half display: title "History", simple amber 9-week streak chip, a concise list of recent sessions "Today", "Wednesday", "Monday", each "Run · Norwegian 4×4" and "40 min"; Today selected with subtle blue tinted rounded row. Right region selected session detail: heading "Today’s session", subheading "Run · 40 min", compact 2x2 summary grid "AVG HR 158", "MAX HR 174", "WORK IN ZONE 84%", "ACTIVE TIME 40:00". Beneath a beautiful wide HR chart contained entirely within right region, muted target bands and a segmented phase strip below; then four interval chips "1" "2" "3" "4", first selected and a readable interval result "Work 1 · 4:00" "In zone 82%". A small Share icon button near title. Chart looks like real exercise HR rising and recovering, not ECG. Show existing recorded metrics only, no calories or fabricated AI. Premium native iOS screens with generous spacing, clear hierarchy, restrained glows. This is a concept board, not official hardware art.
